item.title: Classified Estimates Show the NSA Is Paying Billions to Test AI Models
item.description:
📝 The NSA’s Artificial Intelligence Security Center has been testing frontier models to identify potential national security vulnerabilities. But after a string of high-profile hacking and security incidents, the NSA’s Artificial Intelligence Security Center began testing frontier models to identify potential national security vulnerabilities. Some tech leaders, like billionaire Elon Musk, have suggested that the frontier labs should review each other’s models prior to their release without government oversight.
🔗 Read more: https://www.washingtonsun.com/technology/classified-estimates-nsa-paying-billions-to-test-ai-models
